purpose: Development-only exploratory diagnosis; no replacement of frozen GO tests
rank_scope: Exactly original Stage4 OOF ledger dates; equal-weight daily Spearman average with average ties and minimum 10 observations
fair_comparison: Finite label AND old ensemble AND new ensemble on identical stock-date rows; component tests also disclose their own pairwise common mask
leave_one_out: Every stock, recompute cross-sectional ranks; sort absolute new RankIC change and new-minus-old RankIC change separately
old_head_test: Preserve exact old descending mean(slow_residual_ensemble * ABSOLUTE label) selection including original ceil(5% * stock count)
random_full_backtest_selection: First ten draws, never selected by outcome
random_families: same modal OOF industry and nearest OOF history length among 10 closest remaining stocks, random without replacement
matching_notes: Exclude the target head set from matched controls to diagnose comparable non-head deletion; report unavailable matches and industry fallback. Uniform controls may overlap heads. Modal industry/history length are retrospective diagnostic matching variables, never trading inputs.
full_backtests: A and D, cost x1, all 5 folds and 5 phases, original cash resets, constraints and fees. Baseline plus all 3 head sets, single-stock removal of each head-set leader, first 10 matched and 10 uniform controls for each head set.
deletion_semantics: Remove securities from trading/ranking candidates over whole OOF; retain frozen signal values, all price/status rows for valuation, original calendar and membership coverage denominator; reference universe and residual estimation unchanged. Re-rank remaining candidates and execute portfolio afresh, no direct subtraction of winners.
attribution: Instrument unchanged original buy/sell/gain events in memory; daily per-stock contribution = (mark-to-market gain - stock-specific fees) / previous NAV. Link with preceding compounded OOF phase NAV, then average 5 phase contributions. Sum equals mean phase terminal total return, not median annual return.
reconciliation: Reproduced baseline A/D daily net/gross return, NAV, cash, holdings, turnover, fees must match frozen ledger at absolute tolerance 1e-10 before attribution or reruns are interpreted
inference: All heads selected ex post on reused Development; random-removal percentiles are descriptive stress diagnostics, not preregistered p-values or proof of future performance. No signal deletion, gate revision or production change. Full-rerun random sample limited to 10 per family/head, so tail inference weak.
data_checks: Inspect duplicates, finite/positive adjusted prices, extreme open-to-open returns and raw-vs-adjusted divergence for held head securities; flags require source verification and are not proof of erroneous data
industry_checks: Attribute PnL and average holdings weight using dated industries; report share of positive contributions separately from net contribution share
marginal_signals: Only report original and common-sample IC diagnostics here. Any future component removal needs a separately fixed ablation protocol and independent/forward validation.
